title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: coap_oscore_auth_result struct has _Nonnull on pointer fields but can be zeroed
description: In coap_oscore.h:124-130, struct coap_oscore_auth_result declares ctx and payload with _Nonnull annotations, but coap_oscore_auth_mutating() calls memset(result, 0, sizeof(*result)) at line 251 of coap_oscore.c, which sets ctx=NULL and payload=NULL. The _Nonnull annotation is a contract violation since the struct starts life zeroed and the non-OSCORE (local admin) path explicitly sets result->ctx = NULL at line 301. This can cause UB if a caller dereferences ctx without checking for NULL first, or triggers compiler optimizations based on the _Nonnull assumption. Fix: remove _Nonnull from struct fields or initialize differently.
